checks.explanation: This is a highly subjective claim about US propensity for conflict that is not clearly falsifiable or confirmable from public record.
Direct US-Russia war never occurred, so this conditional market-crash prediction's premise was never met.
The United States did not enter into a significant external military conflict during 2022.
The Federal Reserve raised rates far more aggressively in 2022 than five 25-basis-point hikes, ultimately delivering seven hikes totaling 425 basis points, including several 75bp increases.
The Fed's 2022 tightening cycle brought elevated recession risk and significant market pain, but a clean recession was never officially declared for that period.
Many companies did cite supply chain disruptions in their Q1/Q2 2022 earnings, though the specific 20-30% revenue miss magnitude across multiple companies was not uniformly documented.
Global supply chain disruptions substantially eased through late 2022 into early 2023, broadly matching the predicted timeline.
Supply chain and CapEx-related disruptions affecting major manufacturers largely resolved within the predicted roughly 6-9 month window by early 2023.
Cellular reprogramming and Altos Labs received substantial mainstream media coverage throughout 2022, including major magazine features.
